decisions.statement: A value comes from the page with that value rather than from a file beside the app.
The keys written are the keys that resource has.
A resource no page places a value in is refused rather than written as an empty file.
The public copies are minted only where a Supabase key is among the secrets.
A secret the resource already names is never overwritten by a minted value.
The file is written readable by its owner alone.
The file says at its head that the file is not committed.
The pages are read from the worktree the app runs in.
The write is named here, so every caller names it the same way.
A value the resource names only under its public spelling is copied to the browser name too.

definition: the `.env.local` an app reads, made from the secret pages placing the app's values
